## Loading data and checking alignment

```{r}
metadata = readRDS('../Data/raw/metadata_in_vitro.rds')
head(metadata)
str(metadata)
dim(metadata)
```

```{r}
gene_counts = readRDS("../Data/raw/data_in_vitro_gene.rds")
dim(gene_counts)
gene_counts[1:6, 1:6]
head(colnames(gene_counts))
head(rownames(gene_counts))
```

```{r}
metadata = metadata[colnames(gene_counts), ]
all(colnames(gene_counts) == rownames(metadata))
```

## Data quality control

The first check determined if there were any missing values, neagtive
values, and what the minimum and maximum counts are, as well as the
decimal values of the results

```{r}
sum(is.na(gene_counts))
sum(gene_counts < 0)
range(gene_counts)
sum(gene_counts %% 1 !=0)
```

Next the genes with a zero count will be removed

```{r}
gene_count_filter = gene_counts[rowSums(gene_counts) > 0, ]

dim(gene_counts)
dim(gene_count_filter)
```

The samples have been reduced down to 51646 genes

```{r}
library_size = colSums(gene_count_filter)
library_size

barplot(library_size, las = 2, 
        main = "Library Size Across Samples",
        ylab = "Total Read Counts",
        xlab = "Samples",
        col = "olivedrab3")
```

visualising the library size distribution

```{r}
boxplot(library_size / 1e6, 
        main = "Library Size Across Samples",
        ylab = "Total Gene Counts (Millions)",
        xlab = "Samples",
        col = "rosybrown1",
        las = 2)
abline(h = median(library_size / 1e6),
       col = "maroon",
       lty = 2)
```

-   No obvious outliers
-   average is almost 60 million reads
-   largest sample is approximatley 90 million reads
-   smallest sample is approximately 30 million reads

## PCA

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
```

```{r}
colnames(metadata)
table(metadata$treatment)
table(metadata$donor)


donor = factor(metadata$donor)
treatment = factor(metadata$treatment)
treatment = relevel(metadata$treatment, ref = "air")



dds = DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = gene_count_filter, colData = metadata, design =  ~ donor + treatment)

dds
```

```{r}
dds = DESeq(dds)
resultsNames(dds)
```

```{r}
results = results(dds, name = "treatment_CS_vs_air")
summary(results)
head(results)

```

upregulated - genes w higher expression after CS exposure compared to
air downregulated - genes w lower expression after CS exposure compared
to air

more genes were downregulated

Determining the most significant genes:

```{r}
res_ordered = results[order(results$padj), ]
head(res_ordered, 10)

res_sig = results[!is.na(results$padj) & results$padj < 0.1, ]
dim(res_sig)
```

```{r}
table(metadata$donor, metadata$treatment)
table(metadata$disease, metadata$treatment)
```

### Volcano Plot

```{r}
plotMA(results, 
       main = "CS vs Air",
       ylim = c(-5,5))
```

```{r}
plot(results$log2FoldChange, 
     -log10(results$padj),
     pch = 20,
     col = ifelse(results$padj < 0.1 & results$log2FoldChange > 0, "deeppink4",
                  
                  ifelse(results$padj < 0.1 & results$log2FoldChange < 0, 
                         "cadetblue", "khaki2")),
     xlab = "Log2 Fold Change (CS vs Air)",
     ylab = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
     main = "Volcano Plot: CS vs Air")

abline(v = 0, lty = 2)
abline(h = -log10(0.1), lty = 2)
```

Red - upregulated genes Blue - Significantly downregulated genes
Yellow - not statistically significant genes

```{r}
vsd = vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
pcaData = plotPCA(vsd,
                  intgroup = c("treatment", "donor"),
                  returnData = TRUE)
percentVar = round(100* attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))


library(ggplot2)
ggplot(pcaData, aes(
  x = PC1,
  y = PC2,
  colour = treatment,
  shape = donor
))+
  geom_point(size = 3)+
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% varience"))+
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% varience"))+
  ggtitle("PCA: Cigarette Smoke vs Air")+
  theme_classic()

```

clustering by primary donor rather than treatment - donor specific
differences are a major source of variation in gene expression

Heatmap:

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pheatmap")
}

library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
top_genes = head(rownames(res_ordered),50)

heatmap_data = assay(vsd)[top_genes, ]
heatmap_scaled = t(scale(t(heatmap_data)))

annotation = as.data.frame(colData(vsd)[, c("treatment", "donor")])
rownames(annotation) = colnames(heatmap_scaled)


pheatmap(heatmap_scaled,
         annotation_col = annotation,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         main = "Top 50 Differently Expressed Genes")
```

higher expression in CS (red) air has a lower relative expression (blue)
in the same genes expression patterns differ between treatment groups
